description: Django is a free and open-source web framework that follows the model-template-views architectural pattern.

audience_guidance.student: Django builds web apps quickly. If 'DEBUG' is left on, it shows attackers detailed error screens with sensitive info.
audience_guidance.developer: Ensure DEBUG=False in production settings. Keep SECRET_KEY out of version control. Set SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT=True.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Trigger a 404 or 500 error to see if Django's yellow debug page is enabled. This leaks settings and environment variables.
audience_guidance.pentester: Look for exposed /admin panels. If DEBUG is True, exploit information disclosure.
audience_guidance.security_team: Enforce automated checks that reject PRs with DEBUG=True in production settings.
